==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] or [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chocolate#Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:White Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure== 
# Heat the milk.
# While heating the milk/water put the other ingredients in a mug and mix them very well. It's best if you try to grind it a bit using a spoon.
# Fill half the mug with hot milk and stir very well.
# Add the remaining milk to the mixture.
